tools.name: get_phonebridge_runtime_info
tools.description: Return runtime identity so callers can detect stale PhoneBridge processes after upgrades.

tools.name: list_android_devices
tools.description: List Android devices visible to ADB and their authorization states.

tools.name: get_android_wireless_status
tools.description: Inspect USB/wireless ADB transports and local mDNS pairing/connect services without changing device state.

tools.name: pair_android_wireless
tools.description: Pair this workstation to one private/local Wireless ADB endpoint using a six-digit one-time code.

tools.name: connect_android_wireless
tools.description: Connect ADB to one already-paired private/local Wireless ADB endpoint.

tools.name: refresh_android_wireless_connection
tools.description: Run one bounded transport recovery: prefer one local mDNS service, else one known offline endpoint.

tools.name: disconnect_android_wireless
tools.description: Disconnect one private/local Wireless ADB endpoint without revoking its pairing authorization.

tools.name: get_android_device_state
tools.description: Return a stable device/session guard snapshot including lock, orientation, and visible surface.

tools.name: get_android_screen_size
tools.description: Return the active Android display size in pixels.

tools.name: get_android_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current Android screen as a PNG image.

tools.name: read_android_ui
tools.description: Return the current Android accessibility/UIAutomator hierarchy as XML.

tools.name: get_local_vision_status
tools.description: Return whether the optional localhost-only Ollama/LM Studio vision adapter is configured.

tools.name: get_android_fast_context
tools.description: Return compact Android UI context and invoke the local VLM only when useful or explicitly forced.

tools.name: verify_android_state_change
tools.description: Compare current Android semantic/surface/optional visual state using the shared Yunkai verification contract.

tools.name: get_android_screen_context
tools.description: Return a compact accessibility/UI snapshot and whether screenshot vision is recommended.

tools.name: find_android_ui_elements
tools.description: Find Android UI elements by visible text, accessibility description, or resource-id without touching the phone.

tools.name: get_current_android_app
tools.description: Return the package/activity currently focused on the Android device.

tools.name: tap_android
tools.description: Tap one on-screen coordinate.

tools.name: tap_android_ui_element
tools.description: Find an Android UI element and tap its mapped center; ambiguous matches are rejected unless index is explicit.

tools.name: tap_android_ui_element_verified
tools.description: Resolve one Android UI element, tap it once, then verify without automatic retry.

tools.name: wait_for_android_ui_element
tools.description: Wait for one bounded UIAutomator element presence/absence condition without touching the phone.

tools.name: long_press_android
tools.description: Long-press one on-screen coordinate for 300-5000 ms.

tools.name: long_press_android_verified
tools.description: Long-press once, then perform bounded verification without automatic retry.

tools.name: swipe_android
tools.description: Swipe between two screen coordinates.

tools.name: swipe_android_direction
tools.description: Swipe from screen center in one cardinal direction without using raw coordinates.

tools.name: tap_android_verified
tools.description: Tap once, then perform bounded read-only verification without automatic action retry.

tools.name: swipe_android_verified
tools.description: Swipe once, then perform bounded read-only verification without automatic action retry.

tools.name: swipe_android_direction_verified
tools.description: Perform one safe directional swipe, then verify without automatic retry.

tools.name: game_joystick_move
tools.description: Perform one bounded joystick-style hold using ADB input swipe, guarded to the expected foreground package.

tools.name: game_camera_drag
tools.description: Perform one bounded game-camera drag from a safe landscape region and verify it without retrying.

tools.name: type_android_text
tools.description: Type short ASCII text into the currently focused Android input field.

tools.name: type_android_text_verified
tools.description: Type once into the focused field, then verify bounded state change without retrying input.

tools.name: press_android_key
tools.description: Press a safe Android key: HOME, BACK, ENTER, TAB, DPAD directions, ESCAPE, or volume.

tools.name: press_android_key_verified
tools.description: Press one allowlisted Android key once, then verify bounded post-action state.

tools.name: open_android_app
tools.description: Launch an installed Android app by package name, without installing or removing anything.

tools.name: open_android_app_verified
tools.description: Launch an app once and wait for stable visible-surface ownership without retrying launch.

tools.name: get_phone_automation_status
tools.description: Read the localhost Control Center state and saved daily routines without exposing the DeepSeek API key.

tools.name: save_phone_daily_routine
tools.description: Create or update a local daily phone routine for the Control Center scheduler.

tools.name: run_phone_daily_routine
tools.description: Run one saved phone routine immediately through the local Control Center.

tools.name: stop_phone_automation
tools.description: Request that the local Control Center stop before its next autonomous Android action.
